## Summary

Describe the change and the problem or requirement it addresses.

## State Classification

- [ ] Current implemented state
- [ ] Planned/proposed state
- [ ] Documentation-only change
- [ ] Security/privacy change
- [ ] Recovery/restore change
- [ ] Repository/governance change

## Verification

Describe the authoritative evidence used to validate this change.

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks pass where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation matches verified implementation state.
- [ ] Planned work is not represented as implemented.
- [ ] Security/privacy implications were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Recovery implications were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or protected backup content are included.
- [ ] Required repository records were updated.

## Recovery / Rollback

Describe how this change can be reverted or recovered if necessary.

## Notes

List remaining blockers, unverified areas, follow-up work, or intentionally deferred scope.
